name: Exa
desc: Neural search API built for retrieval by AI agents
desc_zh: 为 AI Agent 检索设计的神经搜索引擎与 API，前身 Metaphor
solves: Keyword search returns pages that merely contain the words, and an agent cannot read ten of them. It returns the passages that answer the question.
solves_zh: 关键词搜索返回的只是碰巧含有这些词的网页，而智能体没法把十篇都读完。它直接返回能回答问题的段落。
best_for: When an agent needs source text it can quote, not a list of links to open.
best_for_zh: 当智能体需要的是可以直接引用的原文，而不是一堆待打开的链接时。
